title: Still funding opportunities import
description: Return a UTF-8 JSON array of up to 200 opportunities in a single .json file, up to 1 MB. Verify dates and eligibility for the current cycle against the funder's official sources. Omit unconfirmed fields. Use the name, funder, and cycle as a consistent identity across research batches. Still skips duplicates so existing records and notes are preserved.

cycle.description: Published round or year, such as Spring 2027. Distinguishes repeat offerings.

amount.description: Published amount or range with currency, such as USD 5,000.

eligibility.description: Summarize restrictions that matter to a writer, such as geography, career stage, or genre.

description.description: Brief description of the opportunity and what it funds.

opens_on.description: Published opening date for this cycle.

deadline.description: Published deadline for this cycle. Use a date on or after opens_on. Omit for rolling or unconfirmed dates and explain in notes if helpful.

deadline_time.description: Use HH:MM in 24-hour time as published. Include only when the deadline date and time zone are known.

timezone.description: Time zone from the official source, as published.

source_url.description: Official page supporting the dates, award amount, and eligibility.

checked_on.description: Date you verified the details against the official source.

highlighted.description: Use true sparingly when eligibility, fit, or a near deadline merits closer attention. Explain the reason briefly in notes.
